description: Southen Provincial  Council - Sothern Province Daycare Center Statute, No. 07 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of a new provincial statute (Daycare Centre Statute No. 07 of 2019) that establishes a regulatory framework for daycare centers in the Southern Province. It includes provisions for registration, supervision, development, and administration of daycare centers, establishes a steering board with specific powers and functions, and outlines regulatory requirements. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with new regulations and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
